name: std::filesystem::path::is_absolute,is_relative
intro: Checks whether the path is absolute or relative. An absolute path is a path that unambiguously identifies the location of a file without reference to an additional starting location. The first version returns true if the path, in native format, is absolute, false otherwise; the second version the other way round.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text:
1) true if the path is absolute, false otherwise.

2) false if the path is absolute, true otherwise.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: The path "/" is absolute on a POSIX OS, but is relative on Windows.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Run the self-contained program; assertions check the documented behavior.
